title: Copyback Run Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $Q$, let $T$ be a type of tags, let $S$ be a state type for a two-work-tape seeking machine, and let $\mathrm{upd}:T\times\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})\to T$ be a tag update function. For any encoded input word $x$, four-tape configuration $d$, word $w$ over the record-symbol alphabet, and record data, form the initial snapshot in the copyback phase with source buffer $w$ and empty destination buffer. After $4|w|+6$ steps of the assembled record-step machine, the configuration is the snapshot formed from $d$ with its first work tape replaced by the buffer containing $w$, in the skip-new-position phase with empty buffers. At every earlier step neither designated verdict state has been reached, and throughout the run every work-tape head stays within distance $|w|+1$ of its position in $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Machine $M$ with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $Q$
Two-work-tape seeking machine with state type $S$
Start and finish states for the seeking machine
No designated verdict state before the final step
All work-tape heads stay within radius $|w|+1$ of their base positions
